rows.en: Quick start guide to the MHPSS Minimum Service Package for GENDER-BASED VIOLENCE (GBV) ACTORS
rows.ne: लैङ्गिक हिंसा (GBV) क्षेत्रमा कार्यरत पक्षहरूका लागि मानसिक स्वास्थ्य तथा मनोसामाजिक सहयोग (MHPSS) न्यूनतम सेवा प्याकेज प्रयोग सुरु गर्ने संक्षिप्त मार्गदर्शिका
rows.bt: A brief guide to starting to use the Mental Health and Psychosocial Support (MHPSS) Minimum Service Package for actors working in the gender-based violence (GBV) sector
rows.note: Uses the supplied unreviewed MHPSS terminology.

rows.section: Quick start guide to the MHPSS Minimum Service Package for GENDER-BASED VIOLENCE (GBV) ACTORS
rows.en: What is the Mental Health and Psychosocial Support Minimum Service Package (MSP)?
rows.ne: मानसिक स्वास्थ्य तथा मनोसामाजिक सहयोग न्यूनतम सेवा प्याकेज (MSP) के हो?
rows.bt: What is the Mental Health and Psychosocial Support Minimum Service Package (MSP)?
rows.note: Uses the supplied unreviewed MHPSS terminology.

rows.section: What is the Mental Health and Psychosocial Support Minimum Service Package (MSP)?
rows.en: The MSP outlines priority activities to meet the mental health and psychosocial support needs of emergency-affected populations.
rows.ne: MSP ले आपत्कालबाट प्रभावित जनसमुदायको मानसिक स्वास्थ्य तथा मनोसामाजिक सहयोगका आवश्यकता पूरा गर्न प्राथमिकताका गतिविधिहरूको रूपरेखा प्रस्तुत गर्दछ।
rows.bt: The MSP outlines priority activities to meet the mental health and psychosocial support needs of communities affected by emergencies.
rows.note: Uses the supplied unreviewed MHPSS terminology.

rows.section: What is the Mental Health and Psychosocial Support Minimum Service Package (MSP)?
rows.en: It is based on existing guidelines, the best available evidence, and expert consensus.
rows.ne: यो विद्यमान निर्देशिकाहरू, उपलब्धमध्ये सर्वोत्तम प्रमाण र विज्ञहरूको सहमतिमा आधारित छ।
rows.bt: It is based on existing guidelines, the best available evidence and expert consensus.

rows.section: What is the Mental Health and Psychosocial Support Minimum Service Package (MSP)?
rows.en: The goal of the MSP is to contribute to reduced suffering and improved mental health and psychosocial well-being.
rows.ne: MSP को लक्ष्य पीडा कम गर्न तथा मानसिक स्वास्थ्य तथा मनोसामाजिक कल्याणमा सुधार ल्याउन योगदान दिनु हो।
rows.bt: The aim of the MSP is to contribute to reducing suffering and improving mental health and psychosocial well-being.
rows.note: The mental-health and psychosocial-well-being wording reuses the supplied unreviewed activity wording; it is not clinically validated.

rows.section: What is the Mental Health and Psychosocial Support Minimum Service Package (MSP)?
rows.en: For more information on what the MSP is, why it is needed and how it can be used, please refer to the MSP guide.
rows.ne: MSP के हो, यो किन आवश्यक छ र यसलाई कसरी प्रयोग गर्न सकिन्छ भन्नेबारे थप जानकारीका लागि MSP मार्गदर्शिका हेर्नुहोस्।
rows.bt: For more information about what the MSP is, why it is needed and how it can be used, see the MSP guide.

rows.section: What is the Mental Health and Psychosocial Support Minimum Service Package (MSP)?
rows.en: How is it relevant to GBV actors?
rows.ne: यो GBV क्षेत्रमा कार्यरत पक्षहरूका लागि कसरी सान्दर्भिक छ?
rows.bt: How is this relevant to actors working in the GBV sector?

rows.section: How is it relevant to GBV actors?
rows.en: Mental health and psychosocial support (MHPSS) is an essential component of GBV programming.
rows.ne: मानसिक स्वास्थ्य तथा मनोसामाजिक सहयोग (MHPSS), GBV सम्बन्धी कार्यक्रमको अत्यावश्यक अङ्ग हो।
rows.bt: Mental health and psychosocial support (MHPSS) is an essential part of GBV programming.
rows.note: Uses the supplied unreviewed MHPSS terminology.

rows.section: How is it relevant to GBV actors?
rows.en: While survivors’ experiences vary, the impacts of GBV on mental health and psychosocial well-being can have extensive consequences for individuals, families, and communities.
rows.ne: हिंसा भोगेका व्यक्तिहरूका अनुभव फरकफरक भए पनि मानसिक स्वास्थ्य तथा मनोसामाजिक कल्याणमा GBV ले पार्ने असरले व्यक्ति, परिवार र समुदायमा व्यापक परिणाम निम्त्याउन सक्छ।
rows.bt: Although the experiences of people who have experienced violence differ, the effects of GBV on mental health and psychosocial well-being can lead to wide-ranging consequences for individuals, families and communities.
rows.note: Survivor terminology is absent from G-0.1; a proposal is listed. The mental-health and psychosocial-well-being wording reuses the supplied unreviewed activity wording. “People affected by violence” broadens “survivors” to include indirectly affected people. Revised to people who have experienced violence.

rows.section: How is it relevant to GBV actors?
rows.en: Addressing the mental health and psychosocial needs of survivors and those at risk of GBV, as well as preventing violence, is critical to promoting gender equality, resilience, and recovery.
rows.ne: GBV बाट प्रभावित व्यक्तिहरू र GBV को जोखिममा रहेका व्यक्तिहरूका मानसिक स्वास्थ्य तथा मनोसामाजिक आवश्यकताहरू सम्बोधन गर्नुका साथै हिंसा रोकथाम गर्नु लैङ्गिक समानता, उत्थानशीलता र पुनर्बहालीलाई प्रवर्द्धन गर्न अत्यन्त महत्त्वपूर्ण छ।
rows.bt: Addressing the mental health and psychosocial needs of people affected by GBV and people at risk of GBV, as well as preventing violence, is extremely important for promoting gender equality, resilience and recovery.
rows.note: The frozen survivor label means people affected by GBV and can include indirectly affected people, whereas the source identifies survivors themselves. bt-divergence: The frozen GBV survivor label means people affected by GBV, potentially including indirectly affected people; the source specifies survivors. The frozen form is retained.

rows.section: How is it relevant to GBV actors?
rows.en: The MSP outlines priority activities GBV actors can implement and support to promote the mental health and psychosocial well-being of survivors of GBV and sexual violence and those at risk.
rows.ne: MSP ले लैङ्गिक हिंसा (GBV) तथा यौन हिंसा भोगेका व्यक्तिहरू र त्यस्ता हिंसाको जोखिममा रहेका व्यक्तिहरूको मानसिक स्वास्थ्य तथा मनोसामाजिक कल्याण प्रवर्द्धन गर्न GBV क्षेत्रमा कार्यरत पक्षहरूले कार्यान्वयन गर्न र सहयोग पुर्‍याउन सक्ने प्राथमिकताका गतिविधिहरूको रूपरेखा प्रस्तुत गर्दछ।
rows.bt: The MSP presents an outline of priority activities that actors working in the GBV sector can implement and support to promote the mental health and psychosocial well-being of people who have experienced gender-based violence (GBV) and sexual violence, and people at risk of such violence.
rows.note: Safety draft; review pending. Survivor terminology is proposed separately. The mental-health and psychosocial-well-being wording reuses the supplied unreviewed activity wording. “People affected by” broadens the source's survivors of GBV and sexual violence. Revised the survivor group while retaining the separate group at risk and both implementation and support roles.

rows.section: How is it relevant to GBV actors?
rows.en: How do I find GBV content in the MSP?
rows.ne: MSP मा GBV सम्बन्धी सामग्री कसरी फेला पार्न सक्छु?
rows.bt: How can I find GBV-related content in the MSP?

rows.section: How do I find GBV content in the MSP?
rows.en: Each MSP activity is labelled with icons showing which sectors, clusters, or areas of responsibility (AoRs) are typically well placed to deliver it (colourful icons) or contribute to it (dark blue icons).1
rows.ne: प्रत्येक MSP गतिविधिमा कुन क्षेत्र, क्लस्टर वा जिम्मेवारीका क्षेत्र (AoRs) सामान्यतया उक्त गतिविधि सञ्चालन गर्न उपयुक्त अवस्थामा छन् भन्ने देखाउने रङ्गीन प्रतीकचिह्नहरू वा त्यसमा योगदान दिन उपयुक्त अवस्थामा छन् भन्ने देखाउने गाढा नीलो प्रतीकचिह्नहरू राखिएका छन्।1
rows.bt: Each MSP activity includes coloured icons showing which sectors, clusters or areas of responsibility (AoRs) are generally well placed to carry out that activity, or dark blue icons showing which are well placed to contribute to it.1
rows.note: The final Latin digit 1 is the source footnote marker.

rows.section: How do I find GBV content in the MSP?
rows.en: The purple GBV icon indicates that GBV actors are typically well-placed to deliver an activity.
rows.ne: बैजनी रङको GBV प्रतीकचिह्नले GBV क्षेत्रमा कार्यरत पक्षहरू सामान्यतया कुनै गतिविधि सञ्चालन गर्न उपयुक्त अवस्थामा छन् भन्ने जनाउँछ।
rows.bt: The purple GBV icon indicates that actors working in the GBV sector are generally well placed to carry out an activity.

rows.section: How do I find GBV content in the MSP?
rows.en: The dark-blue GBV icon indicates that GBV actors are typically well-placed to contribute to the implementation of an activity.
rows.ne: गाढा नीलो GBV प्रतीकचिह्नले GBV क्षेत्रमा कार्यरत पक्षहरू सामान्यतया कुनै गतिविधिको कार्यान्वयनमा योगदान दिन उपयुक्त अवस्थामा छन् भन्ने जनाउँछ।
rows.bt: The dark blue GBV icon indicates that actors working in the GBV sector are generally well placed to contribute to the implementation of an activity.

rows.section: How do I find GBV content in the MSP?
rows.en: For more information, see Who should implement MSP activities?
rows.ne: थप जानकारीका लागि ‘MSP गतिविधिहरू कसले कार्यान्वयन गर्नुपर्छ?’ हेर्नुहोस्।
rows.bt: For more information, see ‘Who should implement MSP activities?’
rows.note: The referenced heading is translated as a cross-reference.

rows.section: How do I find GBV content in the MSP?
rows.en: Figure 1 shows activity 3.9, Provide MHPSS through safe spaces for women and girls, as an example.
rows.ne: चित्र 1 मा गतिविधि 3.9, “महिला तथा किशोरीका लागि सुरक्षित स्थलमार्फत MHPSS प्रदान गर्ने”, लाई उदाहरणका रूपमा देखाइएको छ।
rows.bt: In Figure 1, activity 3.9, “Providing MHPSS through safe spaces for women and adolescent girls”, is shown as an example.
rows.note: The frozen activity label restricts girls to adolescent girls, while the source includes girls without an adolescent-only restriction. bt-divergence: The frozen activity label restricts girls to adolescent girls; the source does not impose that age restriction. The frozen form is retained.

rows.section: How do I find GBV content in the MSP?
rows.en: The colourful icon shows that GBV actors are typically well placed to deliver this activity, while the dark blue icons show that Shelter and Camp Coordination and Camp Management (CCCM), Shelter and Settlements, and WASH actors are typically well placed to contribute to it.
rows.ne: रङ्गीन प्रतीकले GBV क्षेत्रमा कार्यरत पक्षहरू सामान्यतया यो गतिविधि सञ्चालन गर्न उपयुक्त स्थितिमा रहेको देखाउँछ भने गाढा निला चिह्नहरूले आश्रय र शिविर समन्वय तथा शिविर व्यवस्थापन (CCCM), आश्रय तथा बस्ती, र खानेपानी, सरसफाइ तथा स्वच्छता (WASH) क्षेत्रमा कार्यरत सम्बद्ध पक्षहरू सामान्यतया यसमा योगदान दिन उपयुक्त स्थितिमा रहेको देखाउँछन्।
rows.bt: The coloured symbol shows that actors working in the GBV sector are generally well positioned to carry out this activity, while the dark blue marks show that relevant actors working in the shelter and camp coordination and camp management (CCCM), shelter and settlements, and water, sanitation and hygiene (WASH) sectors are generally well positioned to contribute to it.
rows.note: The source anomalously places 'Shelter and' before Camp Coordination and Camp Management while separately listing Shelter and Settlements; this grouping is retained, and no combined glossary entry resolves its intended scope.

rows.section: How do I find GBV content in the MSP?
rows.en: For example, these additional sectors may provide a space in which to conduct the activity and may have an important role in informing the community about when and where these activities will take place.
rows.ne: उदाहरणका लागि, यी अतिरिक्त क्षेत्रहरूले गतिविधि सञ्चालन गर्न स्थान उपलब्ध गराउन सक्छन् र यी गतिविधिहरू कहिले र कहाँ सञ्चालन हुनेछन् भन्नेबारे समुदायलाई जानकारी दिन महत्त्वपूर्ण भूमिका निर्वाह गर्न सक्छन्।
rows.bt: For example, these additional sectors can provide space to carry out the activities and can play an important role in informing the community about when and where these activities will take place.

rows.section: How do I find GBV content in the MSP?
rows.en: Here the colourful icons show that Health, Protection and Child Protection actors are typically well placed to deliver activity 3.14, Protect and care for people in psychiatric hospitals and other institutions, while the dark blue icons show that GBV, Nutrition, WASH, and Food Security & Livelihoods actors are typically well placed to contribute to it.
rows.ne: यहाँ रङ्गीन प्रतीकचिह्नहरूले स्वास्थ्य, संरक्षण र बाल संरक्षण क्षेत्रमा कार्यरत पक्षहरू सामान्यतया ‘मानसिक अस्पताल तथा अन्य संस्थामा रहेका व्यक्तिहरूको संरक्षण र हेरचाह गर्ने’ भन्ने गतिविधि 3.14 सञ्चालन गर्न उपयुक्त अवस्थामा छन् भन्ने देखाउँछन् भने गाढा नीलो प्रतीकचिह्नहरूले GBV, पोषण, खानेपानी, सरसफाइ तथा स्वच्छता (WASH) र खाद्य सुरक्षा तथा जीविकोपार्जन क्षेत्रमा कार्यरत पक्षहरू सामान्यतया यसमा योगदान दिन उपयुक्त अवस्थामा छन् भन्ने देखाउँछन्।
rows.bt: Here, the coloured icons show that actors working in health, protection and child protection are generally well placed to carry out activity 3.14, ‘Protect and care for people in psychiatric hospitals and other institutions’, while the dark blue icons show that actors working in GBV, nutrition, water, sanitation and hygiene (WASH), and food security and livelihoods are generally well placed to contribute to it.
rows.note: The institutional-care label reuses the cited unreviewed T111 candidate. WASH and Food Security & Livelihoods terminology are absent from G-0.1; proposals are listed.

rows.section: How do I find GBV content in the MSP?
rows.en: For example, GBV actors can contribute by raising awareness about protection concerns of women, girls, and survivors of GBV in institutions and facilitating links to GBV services.
rows.ne: उदाहरणका लागि, GBV क्षेत्रमा कार्यरत पक्षहरूले संस्थामा रहेका महिला, बालिका तथा किशोरी र लैङ्गिक हिंसा (GBV) भोगेका व्यक्तिहरूको संरक्षणसम्बन्धी सरोकारबारे सचेतना बढाएर र GBV सेवासँग सम्पर्क स्थापित गर्न सहजीकरण गरेर योगदान दिन सक्छन्।
rows.bt: For example, actors working in the GBV sector can contribute by raising awareness about protection concerns of women, girls and adolescent girls in institutions and people who have experienced gender-based violence (GBV), and by facilitating the establishment of contact with GBV services.
rows.note: Reclassified as general safety guidance; review pending. Survivor terminology is absent from G-0.1; a proposal is listed. The original Nepali restricts “girls” to adolescent girls and broadens “survivors of GBV” to people affected by GBV. Revised to include younger girls as well as adolescents and to identify people who have experienced GBV; the institutional setting and service-linking role are retained. The back-translation attaches 'in institutions' to women and girls but leaves GBV survivors outside that qualifier, broadening the survivor group beyond the source's institutional scope.

rows.en: Section 1: Inter-Agency Coordination and Assessment
rows.ne: खण्ड 1: निकायहरूबीच समन्वय र लेखाजोखा
rows.bt: Section 1: Coordination and assessment between agencies

rows.section: Section 1: Inter-Agency Coordination and Assessment
rows.en: Activities 1.1 and 1.2 are particularly relevant for coordination groups in all sectors and AoRs, and cross-cutting MHPSS technical working groups.
rows.ne: गतिविधि 1.1 र 1.2 सबै क्षेत्र र AoRs का समन्वय समूहहरू तथा क्षेत्रहरूलाई समेटेर काम गर्ने MHPSS प्राविधिक कार्यसमूहहरूका लागि विशेष रूपमा सान्दर्भिक छन्।
rows.bt: Activities 1.1 and 1.2 are particularly relevant for coordination groups of all sectors and AoRs and MHPSS technical working groups that work across sectors.
rows.note: AoRs is retained without supplying an expansion absent from the source. Cross-cutting describes the groups' relevance across sectors. Related to different sectors does not fully convey that the MHPSS technical working groups are cross-cutting. The revision makes their work across sectors explicit.

rows.section: Section 1: Inter-Agency Coordination and Assessment
rows.en: They promote effective inter-agency and intersectoral coordination and assessment.
rows.ne: यी गतिविधिहरूले निकायहरूबीच र क्षेत्रहरूबीच प्रभावकारी समन्वय र लेखाजोखालाई प्रवर्द्धन गर्छन्।
rows.bt: These activities promote effective coordination and assessment between agencies and between sectors.

rows.section: Section 1: Inter-Agency Coordination and Assessment
rows.en: 1.1 Coordinate MHPSS within and across sectors
rows.ne: 1.1 क्षेत्रभित्र र क्षेत्रहरूबीच MHPSS समन्वय गर्ने।
rows.bt: 1.1 Coordinate MHPSS within and between sectors.
rows.note: Uses the supplied activity-label candidate unchanged apart from terminal punctuation.

rows.section: Section 1: Inter-Agency Coordination and Assessment
rows.en: Ensuring mutual representation at MHPSS and GBV coordination meetings. Working closely with actors in Protection (including Child Protection), Education, Health, and other areas of work to ensure MHPSS activities for GBV survivors, particularly women and girls, are consistent and mutually-reinforcing. Establishing joint referral pathways and standard operating procedures for the referral of women, girls, and survivors to and from MHPSS and GBV services, including facilitating access to the full range of MHPSS activities as needed (e.g. safe referrals established for GBV survivors and people at risk of GBV to mental health care).
rows.ne: MHPSS र GBV का समन्वय बैठकहरूमा एकअर्काको प्रतिनिधित्व सुनिश्चित गर्ने। GBV बाट प्रभावित व्यक्तिहरू, विशेष गरी महिला तथा बालिकाहरूका लागि सञ्चालन गरिने MHPSS गतिविधिहरू एकरूप र एकअर्कालाई सुदृढ बनाउने खालका हुने सुनिश्चित गर्न संरक्षण (बाल संरक्षण सहित), शिक्षा, स्वास्थ्य र कामका अन्य क्षेत्रमा कार्यरत सम्बद्ध पक्षहरूसँग निकट रूपमा काम गर्ने। महिला, बालिका र प्रभावित व्यक्तिहरूलाई MHPSS र GBV सेवाहरूमा पठाउन तथा ती सेवाहरूबाट अन्यत्र पठाउनका लागि संयुक्त सेवा प्रेषण मार्गहरू र मानक कार्यसञ्चालन प्रक्रियाहरू (standard operating procedures) स्थापना गर्ने र यसमा आवश्यकताअनुसार MHPSS गतिविधिहरूको सम्पूर्ण दायरामा पहुँच सहज बनाउने कार्य पनि समावेश गर्ने (जस्तै, GBV बाट प्रभावित व्यक्तिहरू र GBV को जोखिममा रहेका व्यक्तिहरूलाई मानसिक स्वास्थ्य हेरचाहका लागि सुरक्षित सेवा प्रेषणको व्यवस्था गर्ने)।
rows.bt: Ensure representation of each other in MHPSS and GBV coordination meetings. Work closely with relevant actors working in protection (including child protection), education, health and other areas of work to ensure that MHPSS activities carried out for people affected by GBV, especially women and girls, are consistent and mutually reinforcing. Establish joint service referral pathways and standard operating procedures (standard operating procedures) for referring women, girls and affected people to MHPSS and GBV services and from those services elsewhere, and include in this the work of facilitating access to the full range of MHPSS activities as needed (for example, arranging safe service referrals for mental health care for people affected by GBV and people at risk of GBV).
rows.note: The frozen survivor labels mean affected persons and can include indirectly affected people, whereas the source identifies survivors themselves; referrals remain bidirectional and access to the full activity range remains conditional on need. bt-divergence: The frozen survivor labels mean affected persons, potentially including indirectly affected people; the source specifies survivors. The frozen forms are retained. Bidirectional referrals and access as needed are preserved.

rows.section: Section 1: Inter-Agency Coordination and Assessment
rows.en: 1.2 Assess MHPSS needs and resources to guide programming
rows.ne: 1.2 कार्यक्रमलाई दिशा दिन MHPSS आवश्यकता र स्रोतहरूको लेखाजोखा गर्ने।
rows.bt: 1.2 Assess MHPSS needs and resources to guide the programme.
rows.note: Uses the supplied activity-label candidate unchanged apart from terminal punctuation.

rows.section: Section 1: Inter-Agency Coordination and Assessment
rows.en: Including information about mental health and psychosocial support needs and resources in GBV needs assessments.
rows.ne: GBV सम्बन्धी आवश्यकताको लेखाजोखामा मानसिक स्वास्थ्य तथा मनोसामाजिक सहयोगका आवश्यकता र स्रोतहरूबारे जानकारी समावेश गर्ने।
rows.bt: Include information about mental health and psychosocial support needs and resources in assessments of GBV-related needs.
rows.note: The composite support term is reused from the cited unreviewed T001 candidate.

rows.section: Section 1: Inter-Agency Coordination and Assessment
rows.en: Section 2: Essential components of all MHPSS programmes
rows.ne: खण्ड 2: सबै MHPSS कार्यक्रमका अत्यावश्यक अवयवहरू
rows.bt: Section 2: Essential components of all MHPSS programmes

rows.section: Section 2: Essential components of all MHPSS programmes
rows.en: Section 2 activities (on programme design, implementing an M&E system, caring for staff and volunteers and supporting MHPSS competencies) should be implemented by all organizations delivering MHPSS activities.
rows.ne: MHPSS गतिविधिहरू सञ्चालन गर्ने सबै संस्थाले खण्ड 2 का गतिविधिहरू (कार्यक्रमको डिजाइन, अनुगमन तथा मूल्याङ्कन (M&E) प्रणालीको कार्यान्वयन, कर्मचारी र स्वयंसेवकको हेरचाह तथा MHPSS सक्षमतामा सहयोगसम्बन्धी गतिविधिहरू) कार्यान्वयन गर्नु उचित हुन्छ।
rows.bt: It is appropriate for all organizations conducting MHPSS activities to implement the activities in Section 2 (activities related to programme design, implementation of monitoring and evaluation (M&E) systems, care for staff and volunteers, and support for MHPSS competencies).
rows.note: Programme-management wording draws on the supplied activity-list candidates for 2.1–2.4. The back-translation makes implementation mandatory with must, whereas the source says should. The revision preserves a recommendation rather than an absolute requirement. The back-translation changes the singular “an M&E system” to plural “M&E systems”.

rows.section: Section 2 activities (on programme design, implementing an M&E system, caring for staff and volunteers and supporting MHPSS competencies) should be implemented by all organizations delivering MHPSS activities.

rows.section: Sections 3 & 4: MHPSS Programme Activities
rows.en: The programmatic activities that GBV actors are typically well placed to deliver are:
rows.ne: GBV क्षेत्रमा कार्यरत पक्षहरू सामान्यतया सञ्चालन गर्न उपयुक्त स्थितिमा रहने कार्यक्रमगत गतिविधिहरू निम्न छन्:
rows.bt: The programme activities that actors working in the GBV sector are generally well placed to conduct are as follows:
rows.note: Preserves typical suitability to deliver these activities, without implying exclusive responsibility. The recurring GBV-actor label is proposed separately.

rows.section: The programmatic activities that GBV actors are typically well placed to deliver are:
rows.en: 3.1 Orient humanitarian actors and community members on MHPSS and advocate for MHPSS considerations and actions
rows.ne: 3.1 मानवीय कर्ता र समुदायका सदस्यलाई MHPSS बारे अभिमुखीकरण गर्ने र MHPSS सम्बन्धी विचारणीय पक्ष तथा कार्यका लागि पैरवी गर्ने।
rows.bt: 3.1 Orient humanitarian actors and community members on MHPSS and advocate for MHPSS-related considerations and actions.
rows.note: Retains the supplied unreviewed activity-label wording.

rows.section: The programmatic activities that GBV actors are typically well placed to deliver are:
rows.en: Orienting GBV actors on MHPSS and interlinkages between GBV and MHPSS programming. Advocating to address social determinants of mental health and psychosocial well-being (e.g. levels of social support, exclusion, deprivation, poverty) among women and girls, including addressing risks and promoting protective factors. Ensuring that GBV activities are accessible and meet the needs of people with mental health conditions.
rows.ne: GBV क्षेत्रमा कार्यरत पक्षहरूलाई MHPSS र GBV तथा MHPSS सम्बन्धी कार्यक्रम तर्जुमा तथा कार्यान्वयनका अन्तरसम्बन्धबारे अभिमुखीकरण गर्ने। महिला तथा बालिकाहरूको मानसिक स्वास्थ्य र मनोसामाजिक कल्याणका सामाजिक निर्धारकहरू (जस्तै, सामाजिक सहयोगको स्तर, बहिष्करण, वञ्चितता, गरिबी) सम्बोधन गर्न पैरवी गर्ने र यसमा जोखिमहरू सम्बोधन गर्ने तथा संरक्षणकारी कारकहरू प्रवर्द्धन गर्ने कार्य पनि समावेश गर्ने। GBV गतिविधिहरू पहुँचयोग्य हुने र मानसिक स्वास्थ्यसम्बन्धी अवस्थाहरू भएका व्यक्तिहरूका आवश्यकता पूरा गर्ने सुनिश्चित गर्ने।
rows.bt: Orient actors working in the GBV sector on MHPSS and the interrelationships of GBV and MHPSS-related programme planning and implementation. Advocate for addressing the social determinants of the mental health and psychosocial well-being of women and girls (for example, level of social support, exclusion, deprivation, poverty), and include in this the work of addressing risks and promoting protective factors. Ensure that GBV activities are accessible and meet the needs of people with mental health conditions.
rows.note: Mental health conditions remain a broad category, and the source's girls are not restricted to adolescents.

rows.section: The programmatic activities that GBV actors are typically well placed to deliver are:
rows.en: 3.2 Orient frontline workers and community leaders in basic psychosocial support skills
rows.ne: 3.2 अग्रपंक्तिका कार्यकर्ता र सामुदायिक अगुवालाई आधारभूत मनोसामाजिक सहयोग सीपमा अभिमुखीकरण गर्ने।
rows.bt: 3.2 Orient frontline workers and community leaders in basic psychosocial support skills.
rows.note: Reuses the cited unreviewed activity candidate, including its existing psychosocial-support skills wording.

rows.section: The programmatic activities that GBV actors are typically well placed to deliver are:
rows.en: Orienting frontline GBV staff on basic psychosocial support skills.
rows.ne: GBV क्षेत्रमा अग्रपंक्तिमा कार्यरत कर्मचारीलाई आधारभूत मनोसामाजिक सहयोग सीपमा अभिमुखीकरण गर्ने।
rows.bt: Orient staff working on the frontline in the GBV sector in basic psychosocial support skills.
rows.note: The support-skills phrase is reused exactly from the cited unreviewed T099 candidate; the actor is specifically frontline GBV staff.

rows.section: The programmatic activities that GBV actors are typically well placed to deliver are:
rows.en: 3.3 Disseminate key messages to promote mental health and psychosocial well-being
rows.ne: 3.3 मानसिक स्वास्थ्य तथा मनोसामाजिक कल्याण प्रवर्द्धन गर्न मुख्य सन्देशहरू प्रसार गर्ने।
rows.bt: 3.3 Disseminate key messages to promote mental health and psychosocial well-being.
rows.note: Retains the cited unreviewed activity-label candidate.

rows.section: The programmatic activities that GBV actors are typically well placed to deliver are:
rows.en: Identifying and incorporating key MHPSS messages into GBV activities and informational materials.
rows.ne: MHPSS सम्बन्धी मुख्य सन्देशहरू पहिचान गरी GBV गतिविधिहरू र सूचनामूलक सामग्रीमा समावेश गर्ने।
rows.bt: Identify key messages related to MHPSS and include them in GBV activities and informational materials.

rows.section: The programmatic activities that GBV actors are typically well placed to deliver are:
rows.en: 3.4 Support new and pre-existing group-based community MHPSS activities
rows.ne: 3.4 नयाँ तथा पहिलेदेखि सञ्चालित समूहमा आधारित सामुदायिक MHPSS गतिविधिलाई सहयोग गर्ने।
rows.bt: 3.4 Support new and already operating group-based community MHPSS activities.
rows.note: Uses the supplied activity candidate, retaining its existing inflected wording rather than replacing it with T079.

rows.section: The programmatic activities that GBV actors are typically well placed to deliver are:
rows.en: Supporting pre-existing community initiatives and facilitating new group-based community initiatives that promote the mental health and psychosocial well-being of community members, particularly women and girls. For example, strengthening the capacity in women support groups to promote the mental health and psychosocial well-being of women and girls participating in their activities.
rows.ne: पहिलेदेखि सञ्चालित सामुदायिक पहलहरूलाई सहयोग गर्ने र समूहमा आधारित नयाँ सामुदायिक पहलहरू सहज बनाउने, जसले समुदायका सदस्यहरू, विशेष गरी महिला तथा बालिकाको मानसिक स्वास्थ्य तथा मनोसामाजिक कल्याण प्रवर्द्धन गर्छन्। उदाहरणका लागि, महिला सहयोग समूहका गतिविधिहरूमा सहभागी महिला तथा बालिकाको मानसिक स्वास्थ्य तथा मनोसामाजिक कल्याण प्रवर्द्धन गर्न ती समूहहरूको क्षमता सुदृढ गर्ने।
rows.bt: Support existing community initiatives and facilitate new group-based community initiatives that promote the mental health and psychosocial well-being of community members, especially women and girls. For example, strengthen the capacity of women's support groups to promote the mental health and psychosocial well-being of women and girls participating in those groups' activities.
rows.note: The mental-health and well-being wording reuses the cited unreviewed T100 candidate. Both existing initiatives and new group-based initiatives are retained. Both occurrences of girls were narrowed to adolescent girls. The revision removes that age restriction and explicitly applies the mental-health and psychosocial-well-being purpose to both existing and new initiatives.

rows.section: The programmatic activities that GBV actors are typically well placed to deliver are:
rows.en: 3.7 Promote caregivers’ mental health and psychosocial well-being and strengthen their capacity to support children
rows.ne: 3.7 हेरचाहकर्ताको मानसिक स्वास्थ्य तथा मनोसामाजिक कल्याण प्रवर्द्धन गर्ने र बालबालिकालाई सहयोग गर्ने उनीहरूको क्षमता सुदृढ गर्ने।
rows.bt: 3.7 Promote caregivers' mental health and psychosocial well-being and strengthen their capacity to support children.
rows.note: Retains the cited unreviewed activity-label candidate.

rows.section: The programmatic activities that GBV actors are typically well placed to deliver are:
rows.en: Supporting caregivers affected by GBV to look after their own physical and mental health needs and promoting positive caregiving skills.
rows.ne: GBV बाट प्रभावित हेरचाहकर्तालाई आफ्नै शारीरिक तथा मानसिक स्वास्थ्यका आवश्यकताको ख्याल राख्न सहयोग गर्ने र सकारात्मक हेरचाह गर्ने सीप प्रवर्द्धन गर्ने।
rows.bt: Support caregivers affected by GBV to look after their own physical and mental health needs and promote positive caregiving skills.
rows.note: This is general caregiving guidance, not a clinical intervention. Existing mental-health wording is reused from T104; no new clinical term is introduced.

rows.section: The programmatic activities that GBV actors are typically well placed to deliver are:
rows.en: 3.9 Provide MHPSS through women and girls safe spaces
rows.ne: 3.9 महिला तथा किशोरीका लागि सुरक्षित स्थलमार्फत MHPSS प्रदान गर्ने।
rows.bt: 3.9 Provide MHPSS through safe spaces for women and adolescent girls.
rows.note: The frozen activity label restricts girls to adolescent girls, while the source includes girls without an adolescent-only restriction. bt-divergence: The frozen activity label restricts girls to adolescent girls; the source does not impose that age restriction. The frozen form is retained.

rows.section: The programmatic activities that GBV actors are typically well placed to deliver are:
rows.en: Providing MHPSS activities for all women and adolescent girls, including survivors of GBV, for example, individual and/or group activities that promote the mental health and psychosocial well-being of women and girls.
rows.ne: GBV भोगेका महिला तथा किशोरीसहित सबै महिला तथा किशोरीका लागि MHPSS गतिविधिहरू प्रदान गर्ने; उदाहरणका लागि, महिला तथा बालिकाको मानसिक स्वास्थ्य तथा मनोसामाजिक कल्याण प्रवर्द्धन गर्ने व्यक्तिगत र/वा सामूहिक गतिविधिहरू प्रदान गर्ने।
rows.bt: Provide MHPSS activities for all women and adolescent girls, including women and adolescent girls who have experienced GBV; for example, provide individual and/or group activities that promote the mental health and psychosocial well-being of women and girls.
rows.note: The population remains all women and adolescent girls, including GBV survivors. Existing well-being wording is reused from T100; the broader GBV-survivor label is proposed separately. People affected by GBV is broader than survivors of GBV. The revision identifies women and adolescent girls who experienced GBV, while retaining eligibility for all women and adolescent girls. In the example, girls is no longer narrowed to adolescents.

rows.bt: 2 It is not appropriate to take these examples as a complete list.
rows.note: Must not strengthens the source's should not. The revision retains the non-exhaustiveness guidance without making it an absolute prohibition.

rows.ne: कार्यहरूको अझ व्यापक सूचीका लागि प्रत्येक MSP गतिविधिअन्तर्गतका जाँचसूचीहरू हेर्नुहोस्।
rows.bt: For a more comprehensive list of actions, see the checklists under each MSP activity.

rows.section: The programmatic activities that GBV actors are typically well placed to deliver are:
rows.en: 3.11 Provide MHPSS as part of clinical care for survivors of sexual violence and intimate partner violence
rows.ne: 3.11 यौन हिंसा तथा घनिष्ठ साथीद्वारा हुने हिंसाबाट प्रभावितहरूको क्लिनिकल हेरचाहको अङ्गका रूपमा MHPSS प्रदान गर्ने।
rows.bt: 3.11 Provide MHPSS as part of the clinical care of those affected by sexual violence and violence by an intimate partner.
rows.note: The frozen activity label uses affected-person wording that can include indirectly affected people, whereas the source specifies survivors of sexual violence and intimate partner violence. bt-divergence: The frozen activity label refers to people affected by sexual violence and intimate partner violence, potentially including indirectly affected people; the source specifies survivors. The frozen form is retained.

rows.section: The programmatic activities that GBV actors are typically well placed to deliver are:
rows.en: Building the capacity of health care providers (including those offering sexual and reproductive services) on aspects of MHPSS specific to sexual violence and IPV (e.g. MHPSS needs of GBV survivors and individuals at risk of GBV, providing first-line support to survivors, managing disclosure, survivor centered approach, facilitating links and referrals to additional services).
rows.ne: यौन हिंसा र IPV सँग विशेष रूपमा सम्बन्धित MHPSS का पक्षहरूमा स्वास्थ्य सेवा प्रदायकहरूको (यौन तथा प्रजननसम्बन्धी सेवा दिनेहरू सहित) क्षमता विकास गर्ने (जस्तै, GBV बाट प्रभावित व्यक्तिहरू र GBV को जोखिममा रहेका व्यक्तिहरूका MHPSS आवश्यकताहरू, प्रभावित व्यक्तिहरूलाई प्रारम्भिक सहयोग प्रदान गर्ने कार्य, हिंसाबारे गरिएको खुलासालाई सुरक्षित रूपमा सम्हाल्ने कार्य, प्रभावित व्यक्तिलाई केन्द्रमा राख्ने दृष्टिकोण, र थप सेवाहरूसँग सम्पर्क तथा सम्बन्धित सेवामा पठाउने कार्यलाई सहज बनाउने कार्य)।
rows.bt: Build the capacity of health service providers (including those providing sexual and reproductive services) in aspects of MHPSS specifically related to sexual violence and IPV (for example, the MHPSS needs of people affected by GBV and people at risk of GBV, providing initial support to affected people, safely handling disclosures of violence, an approach that places the affected person at the centre, and facilitating contact with additional services and referral to relevant services).
rows.note: The frozen survivor labels mean affected persons and can include indirectly affected people, whereas the source identifies survivors themselves; first-line support remains a general support category rather than a named therapy. bt-divergence: The frozen survivor labels mean affected persons, potentially including indirectly affected people; the source specifies survivors. The frozen disclosure phrase also explicitly adds 'safely' to 'managing disclosure'. These frozen forms are retained.

rows.section: The programmatic activities that GBV actors are typically well placed to deliver are:
rows.en: 3.12 Initiate or strengthen the provision of psychological interventions
rows.ne: 3.12 मनोवैज्ञानिक हस्तक्षेपहरूको व्यवस्था सुरु गर्ने वा सुदृढ गर्ने।
rows.bt: 3.12 Initiate or strengthen arrangements for psychological interventions.
rows.note: Reuses the cited unreviewed clinical activity candidate exactly, apart from terminal punctuation.

rows.section: The programmatic activities that GBV actors are typically well placed to deliver are:
rows.en: Delivering scalable psychological interventions to address impairment due to psychological distress and mental health conditions.
rows.ne: मानसिक व्यथा र मानसिक स्वास्थ्यसम्बन्धी अवस्थाहरूका कारण कार्यक्षमतामा आएको ह्रासलाई सम्बोधन गर्न विस्तार गर्न सकिने मनोवैज्ञानिक हस्तक्षेप प्रदान गर्ने।
rows.bt: Provide psychological interventions that can be expanded to address psychological distress and the decline in functioning caused by mental health conditions.
rows.note: The causal link to impairment is retained, psychological distress is not equated with stress, and psychological interventions remain a general category rather than a named therapy.

rows.section: The programmatic activities that GBV actors are typically well placed to deliver are:
rows.en: 3.13 Provide MHPSS through case management services
rows.ne: 3.13 केस व्यवस्थापन सेवामार्फत MHPSS प्रदान गर्ने।
rows.bt: 3.13 Provide MHPSS through case management services.
rows.note: Reuses the supplied unreviewed activity-label candidate verbatim, with the source code retained.

rows.section: The programmatic activities that GBV actors are typically well placed to deliver are:
rows.en: Training GBV case managers and their supervisors on relevant MHPSS topics. Adapting GBV case management tools, templates, and referral protocols to include MHPSS.
rows.ne: लैङ्गिक हिंसा (GBV) सम्बन्धी केस व्यवस्थापकहरू र तिनका सुपरिवेक्षकहरूलाई सान्दर्भिक MHPSS विषयहरूमा तालिम दिने। MHPSS समावेश गर्न GBV सम्बन्धी केस व्यवस्थापनका उपकरण, ढाँचा र सेवा प्रेषण कार्यविधिहरू अनुकूलन गर्ने।
rows.bt: Train gender-based violence (GBV) case managers and their supervisors on relevant MHPSS topics. Adapt GBV case management tools, formats and service referral procedures to include MHPSS.
rows.note: General safety guidance draft; review pending. Proposed missing glossary entries: gender-based violence (GBV) and case management.

rows.section: The programmatic activities that GBV actors are typically well placed to deliver are:
rows.en: 4.2 Provide mental health and psychosocial support to persons deprived of their liberty
rows.ne: 4.2 स्वतन्त्रताबाट वञ्चित व्यक्तिहरूलाई मानसिक स्वास्थ्य तथा मनोसामाजिक सहयोग प्रदान गर्ने।
rows.bt: 4.2 Provide mental health and psychosocial support to persons deprived of liberty.
rows.note: Reuses the supplied unreviewed activity-label candidate verbatim, including its existing clinical wording; no clinical validation is claimed.

rows.section: The programmatic activities that GBV actors are typically well placed to deliver are:
rows.en: Providing access to MHPSS for women, girls, and survivors of GBV deprived of their liberty and advocating for gender responsive MHPSS considerations in detention facilities.
rows.ne: स्वतन्त्रताबाट वञ्चित महिला, बालिका र GBV भोगेका व्यक्तिहरूका लागि MHPSS मा पहुँच उपलब्ध गराउने र हिरासतस्थलहरूमा लैङ्गिक रूपमा उत्तरदायी MHPSS सम्बन्धी विचारणीय पक्षहरूका लागि पैरवी गर्ने।
rows.bt: Provide access to MHPSS for women, girls and people who have experienced GBV who are deprived of liberty, and advocate for gender-responsive MHPSS considerations in places of detention.
rows.note: General safety guidance draft; review pending. Proposed missing glossary entries: gender-based violence (GBV) and gender responsive. “Persons affected by GBV” broadens “survivors of GBV” to potentially include indirectly affected people. Revised to identify people who have experienced GBV.

rows.en: 3.14 Protect and care for people in psychiatric hospitals and other institutions
rows.ne: 3.14 मानसिक अस्पताल तथा अन्य संस्थामा रहेका व्यक्तिहरूको संरक्षण र हेरचाह गर्ने।
rows.bt: 3.14 Protect and care for persons in psychiatric hospitals and other institutions.
rows.note: Reuses the supplied unreviewed activity-label candidate verbatim, including the existing institutional terminology; specialist review remains required.

rows.section: The programmatic activities that GBV actors are typically well placed to contribute to are:
rows.en: Raising awareness about protection concerns of women, girls, and survivors of GBV in psychiatric hospitals and other institutions. Advocating for gender responsive MHPSS. Facilitating links to GBV services.
rows.ne: मानसिक अस्पताल तथा अन्य संस्थामा रहेका महिला, बालिका र GBV भोगेका व्यक्तिहरूको संरक्षणसम्बन्धी सरोकारबारे सचेतना बढाउने। लैङ्गिक रूपमा उत्तरदायी MHPSS का लागि पैरवी गर्ने। GBV सेवाहरूसँग सम्पर्क स्थापना गर्न सहजीकरण गर्ने।
rows.bt: Raise awareness about protection-related concerns of women, girls and people who have experienced GBV who are in mental hospitals and other institutions. Advocate for gender-responsive MHPSS. Facilitate establishing contact with GBV services.
rows.note: General safety guidance draft; review pending. Psychiatric-hospital terminology reuses T015, an unreviewed candidate. Proposed missing glossary entries: gender-based violence (GBV) and gender responsive. “Persons affected by GBV” broadens “survivors of GBV” to potentially include indirectly affected people. Revised to identify people who have experienced GBV; retained the supplied psychiatric-hospital terminology.

rows.en: Rather, relevant organizations must coordinate and work together across sectors/AoRs to ensure that activities are implemented, and a comprehensive response is delivered.
